subject: Offer & Level: Celeste Moreau — escalation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate: Celeste Moreau — level & comp question

Hi Monica / Neha —

Quick heads-up: we completed onsite interviews for Celeste Moreau (applied for Senior ML Engineer) and the interview panel strongly recommended an L5 (senior+). I know People Ops initially scoped L4 for budget reasons. Attached are the consolidated interview notes and a draft offer (offer_draft_celeste_v1.docx).

Why I'm escalating: several interviewers called out systems design breadth + ownership examples that align to L5 expectations (led infra migrations, productionized multi-tenant feature store). We'd like People Ops to revisit the leveling band and compensation range before I extend. If we keep L4, we risk losing her — she has another in-flight offer from a fintech startup.

Ask: Can we get a quick review and decision today? If an L5 isn't approved, I'd like to understand options for a spot equity discretionary uplift or a robust 6-month relevel plan that we can share with the candidate.

Attachments: interview_notes_celeste_ML_team.pdf, offer_draft_celeste_v1.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Engineering Manager, Relevance ML
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Celeste Moreau — level & comp question

Hi Kim —

Thanks for the detailed notes and the flag. I pulled Celeste's interview bundle and the initial leveling recommendation. Per our standard docs, the profile was scoped into L4 based on years in role and compensation banding. I attached the leveling_rationale.xlsx with the mapping we used.

That said, I read the interviewer write-ups you shared and I agree there are several L5-like signals. I can escalate to compensation committee for an exception, but I need the following before I push: 1) brief paragraph from you summarizing the top 3 behaviors that clearly map to L5, and 2) a recommended package (base, bonus, equity) you think is competitive. If committee approves, we can patch the offer and expedite.

If committee needs more context, we may pull a short calibration call (15m) with the panel.

I'll wait for your summary and numbers and will try to get a committee decision this afternoon.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Celeste Moreau — level & comp question

Monica / Neha —

Thanks. See the requested summary below (pulled from panel notes):

1) Ownership & impact: Led a team to productionize a feature store used by three product teams; defined SLOs and owned cross-team rollout that reduced feature retrieval latency by 40%
2) Technical depth: Implemented custom sharding and caching strategy for a high-throughput feature ingestion pipeline — presented tradeoffs and safety nets during the interview
3) Leadership & mentorship: Acted as acting tech lead for 9 months, mentored junior ML engineers, and structured code review standards across the team

Recommended package (target):
- Base: $185,000
- Target bonus: 12%
- RSU / options: $75,000 vesting schedule per our L5 midpoint

Rationale: market in SF Bay is competing for candidates with a minimum base in the high-170s+; the combination above keeps us competitive while staying within our L5 midpoint range. If committee won't approve L5, I propose: (a) offer L4 at $180k base + one-time sign-on $10k + 6-month relevel goal tied to delivery milestones, or (b) approve L5 with the numbers above. Candidate timeline: she expects a closing timeline of 48 hours.

Quoted below is the candidate's recent note (from recruiter) indicating urgency.

"Recruiter: Celeste has two active processes. One is at a fintech that moved fast — they can close in 48-72h if they accelerate. She prefers Redwood but needs competitive terms"

Let me know and I can be on any quick calibration call if helpful.

—Kim

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Celeste Moreau — level & comp question

Monica / Kim —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the materials and Kim's summary. I'm inclined to support an L5 exception here given the cross-team ownership and production impact. Two quick asks for the committee packet:
1) a one-paragraph escalation note (I'll draft) that includes the 6-month success metrics we can attach to a relevel (if we decide to hire at L4 with plan), and
2) confirmation on the absolute maximum total cash (base + sign-on) we would approve if L5 is not available. Please confirm whether $196k total cash (base + sign-on) is acceptable as a ceiling for immediate close.

If everyone agrees, I'll schedule the compensation committee touchpoint at 3:00pm today (15 minutes) and will include Vivek.

-Neha

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Celeste Moreau — level & comp question

Team —

I pulled the committee and we met at 15:00. Outcome: approve a conditional L5 offer subject to a short sign-off flow and a manager calibration note. Options approved:

A) Approve L5 at the package Kimberly proposed (Base $185,000 / 12% bonus / $75,000 equity). Committee asked to keep base within the band — we agreed to lean to midpoint; total cash target in package A is acceptable.

B) If comp or band constraints prevent A (rare), fallback is L4 with $180k base + $10k sign-on + 6-month relevel plan signed by manager and People Partner.

Action items:
- Kim: please update offer_draft_celeste_v1.docx with Package A numbers and send to me for final HR language.
- Neha: please prepare the short escalation paragraph and 6-month measurable goals to attach to the offer (I started a draft and will share).
- Vivek: can you confirm final approval for Package A? We're asking for a quick thumbs-up so recruiting can extend before EOD.

I'll prep the DocuSign envelope after your confirmations.

—Monica

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Celeste Moreau — level & comp question

+1 for Package A. Thanks for the quick triage. Kim — proceed to update the offer and extend with the L5 package. Monica / Neha: loop me in the envelope so I can sign off on the DocuSign.

Given candidate urgency, prioritize speed — if she asks for a faster decision, we can verbally confirm and follow with formal docs within the hour.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference
